overall_intent: An inhabited investigative-fiction photograph of an archive delivery paused to document a cut shipping seal; retain the portrait only as visible face and hair guidance.

grounds.quote: An investigator photographs a broken crate security seal with a scale while the clerk keeps the trolley still

action.reason: Present evidence documentation carries this scene investigation.
action.expressive_goal: Show the investigator deliberately making a record before a stopped shipment proceeds.

owner_relations: Investigator operates the camera toward the crate seal

preserved_choices: Documentation before handling the seal is the current authorial direction
open_scope: Economical procedural detail near the target

action.scene_context: A municipal archive loading bay; cut red seal on the front crate hasp; delivery halted on a trolley.
